channel.title: Finality
channel.description: Finality reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network incidents, exchange and stablecoin developments, regulation and the projects shaping blockchain.

item.title: Binance reopens more withdrawals after $6.3bn hot-wallet theft
item.description: Binance is reopening withdrawals in phases after a $6.3bn hot-wallet theft, adding assets only after security checks as its investigation continues.

item.title: Binance reopens crypto withdrawals in phases after $6.3B theft
item.description: Binance began phased withdrawal restoration after its hot wallets lost about $6.3 billion; the exchange says it has replenished roughly 95% while its investigation continues.

item.title: Binance starts phased withdrawal reopening after $6.3B hack
item.description: Binance plans a phased withdrawal restart after a $6.3 billion wallet breach, while investigators trace stolen funds across ten blockchain networks.

item.title: FBI ties Binance’s $6.3 billion theft to TraderTraitor
item.description: Binance says attackers stole about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets; the FBI attributes the record crypto theft to North Korea-linked TraderTraitor.

item.title: Binance says hot-wallet breach drained $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance says attackers drained about $6.3 billion from compromised hot wallets, froze roughly $3 billion and will cover user losses as the breach investigation continues.

item.title: Binance hit by $6.3 billion theft as attackers exploit hot-wallet access
item.description: Binance says a security breach caused about $6.3 billion in losses; investigators traced the attack across 11 chains, including Ethereum’s EIP-7702 delegation.

item.title: Binance estimates $6.3B impact from unauthorized withdrawals
item.description: Binance estimates a $6.3 billion impact from unauthorized withdrawals tied to a possible DevOps laptop compromise, while saying no wallet key leak is evident.

item.title: Coinbase lists Ripple’s RLUSD across three networks
item.description: Coinbase has opened RLUSD trading and transfers across three networks, adding a new distribution route while reserving Global Exchange collateral support for later.

item.title: Ripple wins final OCC approval for national trust bank
item.description: Ripple says the OCC has given Ripple National Trust Bank final approval, adding federal oversight of RLUSD reserves while issuance stays with its New York unit.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, replacing its consensus protocol
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on mainnet on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with Votor and targeting 150ms finality while leaving wallets, transactions and fees unchanged.

item.title: Ripple wins final OCC charter approval for trust bank
item.description: Ripple says the OCC finalized its trust bank charter, adding federal oversight for RLUSD reserves while issuance stays with its New York-regulated subsidiary.

item.title: Aviva tokenizes £22bn sterling fund share class on XRPL
item.description: Aviva and Ripple launched an XRPL share class for Aviva’s £22bn sterling fund, adding on-chain access while its existing fund structure and assets stay off-chain.

item.title: Solana Activates Alpenglow, Replacing TowerBFT
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on mainnet, replacing TowerBFT with certificate-based voting that targets finality in about 150 milliseconds for confirmed blocks.

item.title: HSBC RedCoin starts phased rollout to PayMe users
item.description: HSBC has begun a phased PayMe rollout of its HKD stablecoin, giving 3.3 million users access to app-based transfers and merchant payments under HKMA licensing.

item.title: Fermi swap: How the router chooses a trading route
item.description: Fermi swap routing can select one venue, pin execution to a chosen venue or split an order; each mode changes how quotes, fallback and output limits work.

item.title: Wall Street’s blockchain shift reaches bank payments and securities
item.description: At Money 20/20, banks and market infrastructure firms described live blockchain services and a coming DTC tokenization rollout, extending transfers beyond banking hours.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin on PayMe for 3.3 million users
item.description: HSBC launched RedCoin on PayMe, opening wallet activation to 3.3 million users for transfers and merchant payments as it brings regulated HKD tokens to retail payments.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin platform rewards under case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars issuers from paying yield to holders but leaves platform rewards to a facts-and-circumstances review, with no blanket safe harbor.

item.title: Solana Token Accounts and the Mechanics of a First Trade
item.description: A first Solana trade moves value through mint-specific token accounts and a signed, atomic transaction; learn what the wallet creates, approves and can reject.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards open to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC finalized its GENIUS Act rules without a blanket ban on exchange-paid stablecoin rewards, but issuer-linked payments can still breach the yield prohibition.
